protocol_basis: nostos-paired-acquisition-support/5.0 unchanged endpoints plus a new family-risk calibration layer

excluded_v5_endpoints.hessian_blob_scale: Search-grid boundary censoring in the v5 pilot.
excluded_v5_endpoints.hessian_tube_scale: Search-grid boundary censoring in the v5 pilot.
excluded_v5_endpoints.variogram_horizontal_curve: Image-axis-dependent definition; replaced by intrinsic directional response development.
excluded_v5_endpoints.variogram_vertical_curve: Image-axis-dependent definition; replaced by intrinsic directional response development.
excluded_v5_endpoints.variogram_range_horizontal: Image-axis-dependent scalar removed after prospective v5 failure.
excluded_v5_endpoints.variogram_range_vertical: Image-axis-dependent scalar failed the prospective v5 gate and is removed, not retuned.

candidate_calibration.method: quantile-binned Jeffreys posterior means followed by monotone isotonic regression
candidate_calibration.stratification: structure for fold balance only; structure is never a predictor
candidate_calibration.selection_rule: Minimum out-of-field Brier score; ties by logarithmic loss, then fewer bins. Gate status is reported but cannot select the candidate.

family_threshold_selection.selector: For each computational endpoint family, choose the most permissive raw-score cutoff satisfying pooled and per-structure risk and coverage constraints plus a structure-stratified reference-field cluster bootstrap bound. No structure-specific threshold is permitted.

comparator_semantics.always_emit: Ignore every NOSTOS hard abstention and emit every computable estimate.
comparator_semantics.conventional_acquisition_qc: Apply acquisition-QC score and acquisition-QC hard failures only; do not inherit physical-sampling or identifiability abstentions.
comparator_semantics.component_ablation: When a validity component is removed, remove both its continuous score and its governed hard preconditions.

intrinsic_variogram.status: separate synthetic development; not yet a paired-acquisition claim endpoint
intrinsic_variogram.primary_object: physical separation by axial direction semivariance surface
intrinsic_variogram.range_rule: Emit an e-fold range only when an interior crossing and finite-field plateau are both supported; otherwise abstain.

access_boundary: All listed CCP and ER fields are development data. No Microtubules or F-actin archive may be listed, extracted, decoded, summarized or visualized during this candidate benchmark.
claim_boundary: Development of risk calibration for paired-acquisition agreement only; not confirmation, biological truth, acquisition-family transfer, diagnosis, clinical validity or intraoperative utility.
